title: Spectrum Noir Illustrator Markers & Artliners | Art Product Review | iiKiui
description:
Hello everybody! 
Today we have a #SpectrumNoir #Marker #Review. I think this is the first time I've reviewed a brush tip marker on this channel! It was super fun having a coloring session using brush tip markers. It feels so therapeutic. I definitely want to review more markers in the future. I've heard good things about the Ohuhu markers and I want to try them out one day. Anyways, I hope you enjoyed the video and drawing!
All the best, 
Nicole 🥝
P.S. Did you like the addition to the intro?
